own_comparison_reconstruction: On a finitely presented affine V-chart, the natural ring map A_C -> completed(A)[1/a] gives the rigid comparison; embed into affine space to identify it with the unit-ball open immersion restricted to the closed equations.

Affine naturality and fibre-product compatibility glue the comparison. Valuative separatedness gives injectivity. Properness supplies a V-prime-valued lift of every closed rigid point over a finite field extension.

The finite-extension valuation ring V-prime need not be finite over V. The proof avoids asserting finite presentation: choose an affine chart containing the closed specialization, then extend A -> V-prime by completeness to completed(A) -> V-prime and hence a rigid point in its unit affinoid.
The comparison is an isomorphism of rigid spaces, hence its associated Berkovich spaces are isomorphic. Lemma5.1.2 closed-point bijectivity alone is not an assertion about all Berkovich points.

For a complete rank-one field, an a-adic Cauchy sequence in V is a valuation Cauchy sequence and conversely. Thus V is a-adically complete and separated. Every c in C becomes integral after multiplying by a^N, hence C=V[1/a]. This puts field GAGA in the stronger proved FK domain.
